        lambda n: n**2,
        lambda n: n * (log(n) / log(2)),  # log base 2 of n
        lambda n: n,
    ]
    
    # Calculate the number of operations for the given complexity function
    operations = complexities[t-1](n)
    
    # Output "AC" if operations <= m, otherwise "TLE"
    if operations <= m:
        print("AC")

    # Calculate the number of operations for the given time complexity
    operations = complexities[t - 1](n)
    
    # Determine if the operations can be performed in one second
